independent_expectation.phase: A before timer at 0.25; B after timer before rising cross at 0.5; C after cross; no initialization event record

comparison.oracle: Hand-derived three stages; initialization and cross restore each element to SEED+i; timer overwrites each element with POLLUTE+i. Sum arithmetic is independent of either simulator.
comparison.native_stage: All q observers and sum must match the same hand stage per instance. Preserve A/B/C records and event brackets. No interpolation across jumps; differing stages remain explicit.
comparison.required_points: 9 exact decimal native anchors, initial and stop are checked separately. Missing exact anchors or stop remain I; no binary64-nearness substitution.
comparison.settings: Record actual Spectre version/selected binary identity, effective time/voltage controls from log+PSF, original immutable RESULT and execution/collection archive identities. One actual configuration contains two instances, not two configurations.
comparison.scope: Static genvar expansion only. No dynamic index, state-dependent condition, runtime loop, event-local snapshot, history call, or complete #65/SAR closure.
